rule: Every task below requires separate explicit authorization. No deployment or Live enablement is authorized by this plan.

tasks.title: Human design acceptance completed
exit: H1-H7 HUMAN_PROVIDED / ACCEPTED under 1646; H3 KST cutoff and H5 sessionStorage applied

tasks.title: Additive schema and repository transaction primitives
exit: Separate DB/role plan implemented
Current migration head and exact fixture scope explicitly authorized
Constraint, permission, ledger conservation and rollback tests pass
Admission disabled by default

tasks.title: Atomic admission and durable reconciliation service
exit: A1 I1 R1 M1 implemented behind verified transaction functions
Two-worker admission, double-settlement and crash tests pass
Unique outbox binds real production owner admission without nested owner locks
No dispatch before admission and marker commits

tasks.title: Public-only HTTP API composition
exit: Exact POST/GET schema, CORS and capability projection
No owner routes, cancel, free-form input or raw errors
Shared read/flood limits proven
Admission still disabled

tasks.title: Real provider profile prerequisite
exit: Separately authorized official model, Responses compatibility and pricing verification
Immutable conservative token/price envelope <= reservation
At most two total calls including retry
Unknown/missing usage truth preserved
Provider credentials isolated; no reliance on monthly budget alone

tasks.title: Deployment packaging, ingress and sandbox proof
exit: Railway trusted peer and header overwrite contract demonstrated with spoof cases
Supervisor termination, no-send fencing and remote-unknown quarantine demonstrated
No public owner DB route or secret exposure
Tool/network/filesystem isolation and Replay independence proven
Actual paid resource/deployment actions require separate authorization

tasks.title: Integrated runtime and adversarial verification
exit: All AISCC_PUBLIC_LIVE_SECURITY_TEST_MATRIX.json cases pass in authorized isolated environment
Real owner chain and synthetic corpus pin verified
Multi-replica restart and unknown-send limits proven
No global caps bypass and no Replay coupling

tasks.title: Frontend bounded Live integration candidate
exit: Explicitly authorized frontend-only scope
Single scenario UI and sessionStorage token UX; same-tab refresh preserved; initial lost 201 has no recovery
Replay works without API
No enablement before Human release acceptance

tasks.title: Human release decision and separately authorized activation
exit: All release prerequisites accepted
Budget, resources, origin and campaign configuration verified
Explicit enablement authorization or Replay-only retained

fallback: Any unresolved release prerequisite retains Replay-only; frozen design does not imply Live implementation readiness.
